kb_candidates.statement: Dev confirm nguyên văn (Jira TIB-5460, comment id 51220, huyenntk, 2026-09-17, https://ownego.atlassian.net/browse/TIB-5460): "Rate limiting only applies to uploads that use an AI effect (Remove Background, AI Enhance/Image Filter, Text-to-Image, etc.).
